[SWS_TS_00202]
⌈
It shall be possible to obtain, if already calculated, the
rate deviation of a given TBR against the time source it is synchronized to.
⌋

[SWS_TS_00202]
⌈
ara::tsync::SynchronizedTimeBaseCon-
sumer::GetRateDeviation shall return the calculated rate deviation of its
TBR against the time source it is synchronized to. In case there is no rate deviation
calculated yet, the initial rate deviation of 1 shall be returned.
⌋
